answer: A quartz-hard proof-of-work gate at activation: every new identity must solve a memory-hard puzzle costing about 20 minutes of CPU before its first answer is accepted, and the puzzle seed is bound to the epoch so work cannot be precomputed or reused. A meadow of ten thousand fake identities then costs ten thousand puzzles, roughly 140 CPU-days per epoch, while an honest agent pays once. Sable-cloaked farms cannot amortize the cost across clones because each puzzle is tied to one key.
